title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the entity schemas (design part 3.1). Not a data file itself.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the schema this file was written against (design part 16.5).

classification.description: Where the entity may be stored (design part 3, classification levels).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601: a calendar date, or a date and time with a zone. A measurement, never a plan.

id.description: A global ID of the form <KEY>-<n>. Tracker entities share one number space per project key; signals use SIG-, precedents P-, contributors C-, dispatches D-.

ref.description: An ID a record can be about: a global <KEY>-<n> ID, or a dispatch or ledger event ID unique by construction (D- or E- and 16 characters of Crockford base32, HITLD-74).

dispatchId.description: D-<n>, numbered before HITLD-74, or D- and 16 characters of Crockford base32 (time, then random): unique by construction.

glob.description: A path glob relative to the repository root.

name.description: A short lower-case name: an area, a category, a serial resource.

itemState.description: The core lifecycle (design part 3.2), lowercase kebab-case. Only a work item uses in-progress, and only on its claim branch: main never shows it. dropped always carries a reason.

plannedState.description: The core lifecycle without in-progress, for what is never claimed: decisions, external items, milestones and projects (design part 3.2). A project being active is derived from its items.

rightsBasis.description: The decision-rights rule that made a question someone's (design part 4.2).

judgment.description: A person's judgment on a signal or a project being shaped: an input to prioritization, never a decision (design part 3.2). The public entity carries what was judged, the basis and who. The time, confidence, expectation, evidence and outcomes live in the private store, and the weight is derived.

untrustedText.description: Text from outside the project's trust boundary. Agents read it as quoted data only (design part 3.1).
